notes.title: A sneaky little Las Vegas peek!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Hoteliers, [/p][p] We know you're all eagerly waiting on a date for the release of the Las Vegas and casinos update, and we'll be able to give you that very soon! 

Today we've got a little sneak preview of what you can expect in the update, and while not everything is in these shots, there's plenty to look at! This way you'll be able to start planning how you want to lay out your casinos and new hotels 😊  

Las Vegas as a map will be 18 x 18 across 8 floors, so that's even bigger than New York with 2592 tiles. It's a huge amount of space to build in and you could possibly have a floor with a mega casino in if you wanted. We're also including 3 financial starting options again for those that like more of a challenge!  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/8d289ca0684505b937d28a6f3a8679824c7a147e.png"][/img][/p][p]The casino zone can be any shape/size that you would like and you can even place it around a bar zone which would be quite fitting. 

You can have multiples of each table, but remember you will need to have staff to cover them all if its suddenly busy. Croupiers are the new staff type coming with the update and they can move between types of table. If one has guests waiting but their current one doesn't, they will head over to run the game. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/0f5a7b5c39520a83013a60ef52fd48c6fa6b409d.png"][/img][/p][p]Casinos can contain a variety of 5 types of casino tables - roulette, blackjack, baccarat, craps and a fortune wheel, plus 3 versions of slot machines for your casinos.   

Each requires a cash deposit and must stay above a certain threshold to remain operational and you’ll need to tailor bet sizes to suit your guest types, just like you do with your guest rooms. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/b64e566c36e3637f6035d65a895d046e0face3b4.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re also rolling out a bunch of new furniture and items to help you capture that iconic Vegas atmosphere! Think glitz, glamour, and a touch of extravagance.. or just a fancy car on show in the middle of the room if you want. [/p][p]Your casinos can be overwhelmingly with bright light pillars and noise or a more dialled back and sophisticated vibe, you decide![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/fd7ca4585bda21ee2dd1a00c48d8479e0e1ac546.png"][/img] 

So what do you think? We hope you're excited and we'll have more news for you soon!   

- The Hotel Architect Team[/p]

notes.title: Update No. 5
notes.content:
[p]Welcome back, hoteliers!   It's been a week since the New York Update launched, we hope you've all been enjoying it, we've seen some fantastic skyscrapers so far! This update brings a bit more polish to some of the new things introduced and squashes a few small bugs as well.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/6892de1bdeff6958af1038bea998f5ecca69c7b6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Style Swapping for Placed Items[/b]
You can now change the look of items [i]after[/i] they’ve been placed! Available colours depend on each item, so go ahead, give that chair a makeover without having to call the construction workers in![/p][/*][*][p][b]Room Cost Reservation[/b]
Planning a room copy? The total cost is now reserved upfront on placement. If you don’t have the funds, you won’t be able to place it so budget accordingly![/p][/*][*][p][b]Room Mirroring[/b]
Flip it to fit it! You can now mirror copied rooms along the [b]X[/b] and [b]Y[/b] axes. Default hotkeys: N (X-axis) and M (Y-axis).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smart Temperature Overlay[/b]
Placing temperature-adjusting items? The temperature overlay will automatically appear, helping you visualize your climate control in real-time.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Instant Clean-up Bug Squashed[/b]
Laundry and dirty dishes will no longer magically clean themselves the moment appliances kick in.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guest Privacy Patch[/b]
Addressed an issue where guest privacy mode wasn’t behaving correctly. Your guests can rest easy now.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Roof Spawning Fix[/b] 
Laundry and litter should no longer mysteriously appear on the roof! Sorry, the party is over! 🤣[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI & Localization Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Main Menu Glow-Up[/b]
Weekly challenge winners images have been updated![/p][/*][*][p][b]German Localization[/b]
Refined translations and improved clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p]Ready to jump in and explore the changes? Let us know what you think, and keep the feedback coming. Happy building! [/p]

notes.title: Location Deep Dive: St Anton!
notes.content:
Set in the Austrian Alps, the St. Anton map location offers a unique challenge, stepping away from our previous urban and coastal settings in Gothenburg and Santorini. Here, you must design and manage a hotel that caters to winter sports enthusiasts and luxury seekers alike!
So what is different in St Anton?

[h2]Ski Rentals [/h2]
In St. Anton, providing ski equipment is essential. Guests expect convenient access to rentals, after all, that’s what they’re here for! Make sure they can rent their skiing equipment so they can head out on the slopes behind your hotel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/bc7af2289f471c8e073308be4103a739dfb5ecb2.png[/img]

[h2]Mastering Temperature Management[/h2]
The alpine environment introduces new challenges in maintaining the perfect indoor temperatures. You need to make sure the place is warm enough but not too hot, so radiators are key! Neglecting this aspect can lead to decreased guest satisfaction, negative reviews and even a very ice-y death! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/82fb767bfe4b37dac35d62422e98a2a9ca56f1d7.png[/img]

[h2]Introducing Saunas: A New Zone![/h2]
St. Anton is the first map where you can unlock and build saunas. These facilities not only boost the hotel's rating but also cater to guests seeking relaxation after a day on the slopes. The question is, will you go down the route of having the full works with a spa or just a small sauna as a practical zone?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/acca8e0b1d3a48d7e4f27a753f37bf6ecf77a72e.png[/img]

[h2]Hot Tips for Success in St. Anton[/h2]
[list]
[*] Invest in Heating: Just like in Santorini with aircon, radiators in St Anton are important!
[*] Use everything you’ve learnt before: You can choose to cater to a particular guest type or all of them but remember to use everything you’ve learnt in other levels!
[*] Try out the new zone: The sauna is an all important zone in this one, see your guests relax and enjoy a break after a long day of skiing!
[*] Don't forget to check out the reward items you can earn on this map - you might find some cool goodies!
[/list]
We hope you've all started to really get to grips with how your hotels run and we'd love to see some epic hotel builds if you want to share in the screenshots area on steam! We might even run a competition for best build at some point in the near future, so get practising 👀

Also, in case you missed it, hotfix No. 2 is now live so if you've been having some issues with lazy cleaners and low gym ratings, they should be fixed! 

Hope you all have a great weekend and happy building! 
- The Hotel Architect Team

notes.title: Bye Bye lazy cleaners - Hotfix No. 2 Incoming!
notes.content:
Hey again hoteliers!

We’ve just rolled out a new update to Hotel Architect with a focus on polish, bug fixes, and quality-of-life improvements. Here’s what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/dcaa9e6f85f39d98d29187d949c74c18bac2e6d8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Guests now correctly order bar refreshments (including sandwiches, popcorn, espresso, tea, and ice cream).
[*] Special room amenities (mini bar, safe, ironing board, vanity) are now fully functional and used as intended!
[*] Cleaners will now mop all tile types as expected - so no more untouched spots or missed tiles!
[*] Laundry and litter will no longer be left behind due to pickup issues.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Resolved a lag spike caused by multiple inputs during a paused state.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause traffic jams.
[*] Addressed a rare issue preventing save files from loading properly.
[*] Corrected localized text overflow in the settings menu.
[*] Disabling bedrooms no longer kicks guests out; it simply stops new bookings.
[/list]
[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated several in-game text translations for clarity and accuracy.
[/list]
And that's not all, but we won't bore you with the other bits as they're pretty small!

Thank you for continuing to play and we hope you're all enjoying yourselves! Your feedback keeps us improving and we're taking as much as possible on board!

— The Hotel Architect Team

notes.title: Introducing Hotel Architect Location No. 3: Paris!
notes.content:
After the sun-drenched cliffs of Santorini and the coastal charm of Gothenburg, it’s time to step into the elegance and grandeur of the City of Light - Paris! Revealed as the third playable location, this iconic European capital brings a twist to the gameplay: this time, you're starting with a hotel but it's in desperate need of some serious love and care. You may have already tried this map out in the playtest but for those you missed it, this is the blog to get the lowdown on it!

Paris introduces new zones, the spa and conference room, polished mechanics, and five fully buildable floors of Parisian hospitality.
Unlike the serene sprawling map in Santorini or the structured city plot in Gothenburg, Paris starts with you into the middle of a pre-existing hotel that’s seen better days. Think peeling wallpaper, dirty floors and outdated décor. Your mission? Turn this tired old landmark into a luxurious destination worthy of five stars and glowing reviews.

But that’s easier said than done. You'll need to renovate, reorganize, and possibly rethink everything. from the lobby to the penthouse suite of an upper crust guest's dreams... and all while keeping the business afloat and managing demanding guests!

Paris features:
[h2]5 Floors[/h2]
Paris brings a whole new dimension, literally. This is the first location in Hotel Architect to span five floors, however you have less space per floor than Santorini so you'll need to get inventive with layouts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/d1c40403bb71fdc51539033f69877830ac6401d4.png[/img]

[h2]New Zones[/h2]
The new zones in the Paris scenario are the conference room and the spa. Once you've completed the scenario in Paris, you can then take both zones back to the previous two locations.
In order to achieve that all important 5 star rating, you must have a Spa in your hotel, so those 5 star rewards are now within reach!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/414a8ce37524d161df35a3a9cd88719d18c13c33.png[/img]

[h2]New Guest types[/h2]
The Upper Crust and Business People are fond of Paris and while they booked your hotel as their place to stay, they aren't going to let you slack on any of their demands.

Upper Crust rooms in particular, have to be quite large, so fitting them into the floor plan of Paris efficiently can be quite tricky. You'll need to be inventive while making sure that you have everything to maintain that 5 star rating once you've achieved it. 

The business people while they don't require 5 star luxury, they still have their own requirements including the conference room so they can work while they stay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/0dbfc5c48feaf2edc1ac15aca284f8e67893c24d.png[/img]

Renovation won’t be easy, and each upgrade affects your hotel’s operational flow, guest satisfaction, and your ability to earn five-star reviews. But the reward? Seeing a forgotten Parisian hotel come back to life under your vision.

notes.title: New Feature: Character Creator
notes.content:
Hey Hoteliers!
We’ve got something a bit different for you today, the newest Hotel Architect feature: the Character Creator! 
We've rolled it out so you can try it in the final playtest and it gives you the chance to customize your game, or your friends just a little bit more! 

[h2]Create Your Own Characters[/h2]
With the new Character Creator, you can now design and add your very own:[list]
[*] Guests
[*] Staff Members
[*] Service Workers
[/list]

Whether you’re dreaming up a laid-back beachgoer, an overly intense front desk manager, or a chef who may by slightly too flaboyant, it’s all possible!

You’ll be able to customize: [list]
[*] Appearance (from stylish to straight-up chaotic)
[*] Outfits and accessories
[*] Names, voice and even a few behavioral quirks
[/list]

Want to immortalize your best friend as the perfectionist waiter? Go ahead. Give your favourite celebrity a job at Reception? They're hired! This is your hotel, after all.

[h2]Share & Import Characters With Friends[/h2]
Here’s where it gets really fun: every character you create comes with a shareable code. That means you can send your most iconic creations to friends, and they can import them right into their own hotels.

Imagine a whole group of players all being bugged by the same Upper Crust guest named “Sharon” who just won’t stop complaining about her room temperature.
Or maybe you and your friends each create a staff member and build a shared dream team across multiple hotels. The possibilities are endless, and kind of hilarious!

[h2]Need some inspiration?[/h2]
Here are our favourite characters we're created so far and the codes so you can add them to your own game:

notes.title: Zone Focus: Spa & Conference Room
notes.content:
Hey Hoteliers! 

This week we’re giving you a sneak peek at not one, but TWO brand-new zones coming to the final playtest, which is less than 7 days away!  
 
Say hello to the Conference Room and the Spa Zones. These additions are designed to appeal to two very distinct (and higher-paying) guest types: Business People and The Upper Crust. Although, honestly, every guest could use a little productivity or pampering from time to time. 

Let’s take a closer look at how these zones work, what they unlock, and why they’ll be game-changers for your hotel designs! 
 
[h2]The Conference Room [/h2]
Looking to impress the suit-and-tie crowd? The Conference Room is your go-to space for attracting Business People, the guests who are all about productivity, efficiency, and polished professionalism. 

While the Conference Room won’t push your critic score past 3 stars, it plays a vital role in drawing Business People to your hotel. These guests aren’t just looking for a place to sleep. they want a place to work. Expect to see them taking conference calls on their laptops, gesturing passionately at whiteboards, and generally doing all sorts of “important business-y things.” 

Cool tip: Business People pay more per night than your average Backpacker or Sporty guest. They’re a great step up in terms of revenue so alongside sunbathers, you’ll want to bring them to your hotel! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/a4b562436d814f11702684c8e6f72ac5283d43e0.png[/img]

[h2]The Spa [/h2]
If you’re aiming for a more luxurious, high-end hotel experience, the Spa is an absolute must. This is where your hotel goes from just simply nice to five-star fabulous. And here’s the kicker: if you want to attract Upper Crust guests, a Spa isn’t optional, it’s essential!  
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/d652b73c18c114ca6502684b2d4a06911e5bf2db.png[/img]

The Upper Crust are the most elite (and picky) guest type in Hotel Architect. They’ll only stay at hotels rated 5 stars by critics, and one of the key requirements to hit that top rating is, you guessed it, a Spa. 

The Spa offers guests a full suite of relaxation options, including: [list]
[*] Hot tubs 
[*] Mud baths 
[*] Massage chairs 
[*] And more! 
[/list] 

The It’s not just the Upper Crust that will use the Spa though, it is for all your guests to enjoy and it proves to be quite a popular attraction, particularly if you add a tanning bed for those Sunbathers so they don’t require the sunny weather to worship those rays! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/8d5af7d47bccca938bda469b0efe37a100d80af6.png[/img]

We hope you're all ready for the last playtest - it's going to be a blast seeing you build in Paris! 

If you haven't signed up yet, you have until April 23rd to do so and we'll send your codes to you via email, if not you'll have to head to our steam page on the 24th to request access. 

Sign up here: [url=https://Wired.gg/HAplaytest]https://Wired.gg/HAplaytest[/url]

notes.title: Time for our demo round-up!
notes.content:
Hey Hoteliers,

The Hotel Architect Steam Next Fest demo has officially wrapped up, and what an incredible experience it has been!

We were thrilled to see such an overwhelmingly positive response from players around the world. Your insightful feedback, creative hotel designs, and engagement with the demo have been truly inspiring. Last week, we highlighted some of the best builds from Steam Next Fest, and now that we’ve had some time to review and digest your feedback, we’re excited to share some key takeaways and our next steps for development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/6388fab7b4acd7590e6b6b037db4e2270268d103.jpg[/img]

[h2]Your Most Requested Features[/h2]

Throughout the demo, we noticed a few highly requested features that could enhance the building experience and overall gameplay. Here are some of the top suggestions we’re looking into:

Copy Room / Template Rooms – Many of you wanted an easier way to duplicate room layouts, saving time and effort when designing large hotels. We hear you, and we’re are working on a copy/paste function! This means you can either choose to design each room or if you want to skip the design part, you can use copy in a design for those who would like to speed build! (Who's ready to speed run a hotel build? 👀)

Eye-Dropper Tool – We also noted the requests for an eye-dropper style tool that is able to select an item/wallpaper/flooring that has already been placed in game. We happy to say we're working on this feature and it will allow you to quickly select any item, wall material, or flooring, and instantly jump to it's location in the menu. This should make designing and decorating your hotel even smoother, less tedious and more intuitive!

[h2]Fixes & Improvements[/h2]

We also identified a few key areas that need refinement, thanks to your bug reports and feedback. Here are two critical fixes we’ve worked on:

Restocking Issue in the Combo Fridge – Some players noticed that the combo fridge wasn't restocking properly. We’ve investigated the issue and can confirm we have a fix!

Builders Not Fetching Materials at Highest Game Speed – When playing at the fastest speed, some builders failed to retrieve materials, causing delays in construction during the Steam Next Fest Demo. We’re addressing this to keep your hotel development running efficiently at all speeds, no need to watch like a hawk for builders getting stuck during your high speed gaming now!

notes.title: Introducing Hotel Architect Location No. 2: Santorini!
notes.content:
As promised, a deep dive into Santorini before it lands in the Steam Next Fest demo! 

In this blog post, we’ll dive into everything that makes Santorini such an exciting addition to Hotel Architect, from the new gameplay features to the challenges and opportunities you’ll face as you create a luxurious hotel on this picturesque Greek island across 3 floors on a much larger map than Gothenburg!

Whether you're playing in Career Mode or Sandbox Mode, here’s what you can expect when the Santorini location opens up on February 24th (only a few days away!) in Steam Next Fest:

[h3]A Stunning New Setting![/h3]
Santorini is one of the most visually captivating destinations in the world, and this new location fully captures its charm. With its breath-taking views of the Aegean Sea, dramatic cliffs, and iconic architecture, this location brings a fresh and exciting challenge to Hotel Architect. You’ll have the opportunity to design your hotel while keeping in mind as your map is set on the beach front, and your guests will be able to take a dip in the sea!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/aa922e76c4d8e67fd557f0dc75b7a08cf49689b0.png[/img]
[h3]New Guest Types[/h3]
Santorini attracts a diverse range of tourists, from luxury vacationers, sunbathers and more. This variety of guest types means you'll need to design a hotel that caters to different needs. Whether it’s crafting private suites for the brats, or creating an area for sunbathers to tan in those sunrays on the beach. Your hotel must meet the expectations of every visitor whilst dealing with the heat in this location!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/7db79b82fd42fd6bd70b599a932b96ada655540a.png[/img]
[h3]New Zones and Items[/h3]
The new update includes all the zones that came before and a new one, the bar zone! Time to party it up and entertain with a surf and golf simulator and even a light-up dance floor.
There are some Items that are inspired by Santorini’s unique culture, history and architecture, while others are essentials like air con units and fans! These additions will give you more variety to customize your hotel but don't forget the necessities or you might end up with some unwanted guests in your hotel, or worse, bad ratings!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/633b0c36a092ce1dc7de8b17d29a8e91a1af70f7.png[/img]
[h3]We know you've been asking for it.. a bigger map and more floors![/h3]
Building on an island like Santorini comes with different challenges to Gothenburg. However, after learning the basics in Sweden, this map allows you to create on a bigger scale and on an additional floor for more adventurous building!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/72734d8b8825ea5956a13c805600526968d0e594.png[/img]
[h3]The Upgrade Tree![/h3]
This is totally new and we haven't even hinted at it before! This update brings you a new gameplay feature called the upgrade tree. You'll need to learn and research about specific items and topics to unlock better items and improvements such as fancier furniture, bigger capacity bins and combination washer/dryers for towels and sheets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/b05b013745e8a3ec48b48c164c90f6ae6a79b1e8.png[/img]
[h3]Staff Moods[/h3]
Your employees are the backbone of your hotel, and keeping them happy is just as important as keeping your guests satisfied. In this update, staff moods now play a significant role in your hotel’s success. If your employees are overworked and stressed, expect some complaints.. and even the possibility of them quitting! Staff mood notifications will alert you to potential issues, so be sure to balance their workloads and create a positive work environment to ensure smooth operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/4234d739049f98334b1a2dc81f50b6aa0e72b8a8.png[/img]

So mark your calendars, gather your tools, and get ready to build your dream hotel on one of the world’s most famous islands! 

Wishlist and join [url=https://wired.gg/HotelArchitect]Hotel Architect’s Steam Next Fest demo[/url] from February 24th to March 3rd, and let your hotel tycoon journey take you to the shores of Santorini.
If you fancy, you can join us in the [url=https://discord.gg/HotelArchitect]Discord[/url] while you wait too!

See you all on Monday, 6pm GMT sharp for Next Fest! 
- The Hotel Architect Team

notes.title: Hotel Architect's January Playtest is now on!
notes.content:
The Hotel Architect Playtest is Now Open!

The wait is over - Hotel Architect is officially in your hands for the weekend! 🏨🎉

It’s time to build, design, and manage the hotel of your dreams. We’re so excited for you to dive in and explore everything we’ve been working on. Whether you’re aiming for a luxurious five-star getaway or a quirky roadside motel, this is your moment to shine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/e0e766738605ced4ee83a49f1e8c8c4af6137198.jpg[/img]

[h2]How to Get Started[/h2]
If you missed the mailing list sign up, don't worry - you can head to our steam page and request access with a few button clicks! Once you're in, you’re free to start building and managing right away!

[h2]What’s waiting for you in the playtest?[/h2]
If you haven't played Hotel Architect before in one of our other playtests, here’s a taste of what you’ll get to do:
[b]Design Your Dream Hotel[/b]
Go wild with your layouts, choose your décor, and create the perfect vibe. From fancy lobbies to rooftop pools, you’re in charge of every detail.

[b]Juggle Guests and Their Quirks[/b]
Some guests are easy to please… others? Not so much. Keep everyone happy while running the show, because a happy guest means more stars!

[b]Experiment and Have Fun[/b]
Try new things, test bold ideas, and see what works. Want to build a hotel entirely out of suites or maybe you want a capsule room style hotel? Go for it.

[h2]Things added since your last opportunity to play: [/h2]
[b]NEW FEATURES & CONTENT[/b]
[list] [*] Ghosts! A haunted hotel is not just a spooky dream anymore! How to trigger ghosts and at what cost? That's up to you to find out—if you dare!
[*] Zone with multiple rooms: If you build two rooms with the same zone type and add a door between them, they’ll merge into a single unified zone.
[*] Electric machines can now break in two ways: either "in need of repair" (sparks) or "in need of replacement" (explosion + burnt).
[*] Toilets and basins can now get clogged.
[*] Staff candidates' experience level now depends on your hotel stars (the higher your stars, the higher the experience levels of the candidates).
[*] New wobbly placement effect on items.
[*] New furniture items!
[/list] [b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved item rotation system.
[*] Staff XP is now being saved.
[*] Made important notifications more noticeable + added sound.
[*] Added notifications when: a plant dies, a machine breaks, a character collapses, or ghosts appear.
[*] Fixed visual bug in some plants.
[*] Fixed bug in the vehicle system.
[*] Crash report sender: If you experience a crash, a crash report window should now appear. Please click the send button—this way we will receive the report immediately and can help fix it faster. If not during the playtest, we’ll at least try to help with a workaround.
[/list] [b]BALANCING[/b]
[list]
[*] Each guest type now has their preferred items (displayed with icons in the Item list's tooltip) for the following activities: entertainment, refreshment, gym.
[*] Critics will prioritize activities based on your current star level (e.g., they won’t look for a spa in a one-star hotel).
[*] Staff experience level has a higher impact on guest scoring.
[*] Reduced starting money in the Gothenburg scenario from 150,000 -> 100,000.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/8184f89a9dab16dab334d667fd836fb2a442e9f3.png[/img]
[h2]Now, Let’s Build Something Awesome![/h2]
We’re so grateful to have you with us on this journey. Watching you bring your creativity to life in Hotel Architect is going to be incredible, and we’re beyond excited to see the hotels you dream up.


Now, get out there, build something amazing, and don’t forget to enjoy the process (and maybe avoid angry guests).

See you in the lobby!
The Hotel Architect Team

notes.title: Zone Focus: Laundry Rooms!
notes.content:
Behind the polished (or disastrous) rooms and service of every hotel lies an often-overlooked but essential operation: the laundry room! 

As a hotelier and Hotel Architect player, crafting a well-designed laundry system isn’t just about functionality - it’s about ensuring the seamless flow of operations that keeps guests satisfied and the hotel running like clockwork.

During the playtest the team found that a lot of feedback said that the cleaners were not cleaning the hotel efficiently. There are a few reasons for this - one balancing and we adjusted it slightly during the test! 
And another management of the laundry rooms and cleaners, which is what we're going to cover in this blog. These tips will help you when Early Access comes round! (or potentially another playtest *hint hint*)

[h2]Where should the laundry room be located?[/h2]
If your cleaners have a really long commute between the laundry room and the hotel rooms. it'll take a long time to get each room's sheets and towels sorted. You might want to add another laundry room in or have the laundry room in the centre of your hotel complex! 
Whatever your layout, consider how long it takes for cleaners to get to the rooms to clean and refresh the towels and bed linen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/e8fc6dfa4ee2dd7e73eb8bfeee3e64943afa9000.png[/img]

[h2]Help - Cleaners aren't cleaning like they should be! [/h2]
If your cleaners are ignoring other areas of their responsibilities i.e. lots of rubbish on the floor or grubby surroundings in the hotel, it might be that they haven't got enough machines/storage to cope with demand of the hotel rooms. There's only 8 sheets on a shelf, so if you have more than 8 rooms, you will need more sheets!

This means they will only be focusing on their top priority, getting those sheets and towels to those rooms and they'll ignore emptying bins or mopping!

Adding in more sheet and towel shelves and more washing machines and driers can help with this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/cea3caaf467377b4241fafe1c7569397c74a9de7.jpg[/img]

We will be looking at the priorities of hotel staff shortly, however practicing good habits will help your hotel run smoother in the long run.

notes.title: Our First Playtest Feedback & Improvements!
notes.content:
Exciting Updates and Improvements Coming to Hotel Architect!

Hello, hoteliers!

We want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone for your incredible support and valuable feedback on Hotel Architect. 

Your input has been instrumental in shaping the direction of the game, and we're happy to share some exciting news: we've already fixed most of the bugs that were reported, and we’re hard at work implementing new features that many of you have requested. But, that’s just the beginning — there’s a lot more to come!

Before we get down to business with what we're working on we'd like to give a quick shoutout to Hotel Architect Discord Member: [b]RafnUnga[/b], who pushed our playtest beyond our expectations and achieved a 5 star critic rating! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40373120/d6dbdd93d50155fd9e2beb8f4be66f938799b16e.png[/img]
[h2]Key Improvements:[/h2]
Here’s a sneak peek at some of the improvements and features you can expect to see in the near future:
[list]
[*] [b]Move Items After Delivery:[/b] You’ll soon be able to move items after they’ve been delivered, eliminating the need to delete and repurchase. This should make it much easier to tweak your designs on the fly!
[*] [b]Improved Cleaning System: [/b]We're refining the cleaning and cleanliness management to make it more intuitive and reduce your staff's overall workload. Keeping your hotel sparkling clean should feel smoother than ever.
[*] [b]Enhanced Zone Warnings:[/b] We’re adding different warning icons for zones, making it clearer when something’s missing—like required items, staff assignments, or a dinner menu—so you can resolve issues faster.
[*] [b]Simplified Item Grouping: [/b]Items that come in different variations (like colors or sizes) will be grouped together in the item list, making it easier to find what you need without overwhelming the menu.
[*] [b]Material Filtering:[/b] Decorating just got simpler! You’ll be able to filter materials like wallpapers and flooring into categories such as wood, tile, and stone, giving you more control over your design choices.
[*] [b]Better Cashflow Breakdown:[/b] We’re enhancing the cashflow menu with more detailed categories and a pie chart that lets you hover over sections to see actual amounts, not just percentages—perfect for more precise financial planning.
